core.name: world-map-control-edge-normalization
core.notes: Add seam-aware hydrology edge normalization and expose the weights in the generation signature so map previews and server-side masks stay aligned.

core.name: hydrology-flow-memory
core.notes: Blend hydrology with cached flow accumulation across chunk edges so caves, rivers, and lakes share the same flow memory on client and server.

content.name: seam-aware-rivers
content.notes: Apply meander smoothing plus edge tangents when carving rivers so width/depth stay continuous across seams.

content.name: wetland-stable-lakes
content.notes: Use rim stabilization, inflow-based depth scaling, and wetland buffers tied to hydrology variance to reduce stepping artifacts.

content.name: moisture-safe-caves
content.notes: Clamp carving near saturated ceilings, add moisture-aware supports, and align river suppression with hydrology edge weights.

util.name: config-sync
util.notes: Keep new hydrology edge/flow-memory weights data-driven and mirrored between server and Unity StreamingAssets.

util.name: proto-registry-validation
util.notes: Ensure Google.Protobuf generated bindings resolve from the expected descriptor/assembly and that using directives stay valid.
